answer: Pulse sonnet probe: each fake costs ~48 full model runs a day (~$1/day each; N fakes pay N times that). At random moments the ledger fires one pulse to many identities at once, demanding a 14-line sonnet on a fresh per-identity seed within 20s. Replies dock at a public wharf log where pairwise style and timing fingerprints are compared; clones served from one backend cluster and are voided. A farm cannot share a reply, since seeds differ, and simultaneous pulses saturate its GPUs, so latency spikes expose it. Limit: distinct models per fake can dodge style checks, but then pay full cost.
